## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to track a task's progress state — the iCalendar VTODO STATUS (not-started, in-progress, completed, cancelled).

### Avoid when

- Avoid minting a [`Task`](../classes/gmeow-Task.md) subclass for the status (the values are [`gmeow:TaskStatus`](../classes/gmeow-TaskStatus.md) individuals) and avoid deleting a cancelled task — [`gmeow:taskStatusCancelled`](../individuals/gmeow-taskStatusCancelled.md) with displayable false retains it ([Principle 10](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-10)).

### How to use

- Set one [`gmeow:TaskStatus`](../classes/gmeow-TaskStatus.md) value; mark a cancelled task displayable false rather than removing it, preserving the record.

### Examples

- ex:fileReport [`gmeow:taskStatus`](gmeow-taskStatus.md) [`gmeow:taskStatusInProgress`](../individuals/gmeow-taskStatusInProgress.md).
